about: Labelled fan questions for the Companion's tool choice, written and labelled on 2026-10-23 before any router or model was scored on them, never edited after a score. Held-out seeds 920001 (Quarrington v Fenwick) and 920002 (Kestrow v Ashvale), pre-registered for the agents' held-out evaluation. `tool` is the insight tool whose facts answer the question; null means no insight tool does (off-topic or not measured), and the right plan is no tool. A plan is right when it calls `tool` (at most three tools) or, for null, calls none.
